keysight-psg.scope: E8267D native SCPI: CW/fixed frequency and power, OUTP:MOD OFF, RF on/off and readback. No arbitrary modulation waveforms or SAR recipe.

keysight-esg-b.scope: Official E44xxB ESG manual asset, E4400-90324 April 2002. E4421B/E4433B native SCPI CW/fixed power, modulation off, RF on/off. Manual age matches equipment generation, not report issuance date.

innco-co3000.scope: CO3000 remote protocol v2.10, 2016-06-28, firmware >=1.02.60. Manufacturer-authored manual hosted by Reliant EMC. Numeric axis selection avoids conflicting named-select ACK examples. ST scope conflicts between general/device tables; library uses unambiguous ES all-device stop.

rs-fsv.scope: FSV40 spectrum: CALC:UNIT:POW (not FSW UNIT:POW), SAN, trace mode, detector, linear x axis. Both listed order-number generations covered; installed firmware/options still required.

keysight-e3632a.scope: E3632A P15V/P30V 15V/7A or 30V/4A rated limits; VOLT/CURR/OUTP, measurements and error queue. PDF running footer says E3630A, cover/model-specific tables confirm E3632A.

rs-osp.scope: First-generation OSP120/130 host, OSP150 CAN extension. Reviewed B101 SPDT/B102 SP6T numeric channel syntax, module catalog, readback and explicit site safe path. Other modules not enabled.

keysight-e4419b.scope: E4419B window 1 with explicit input A/B, existing 8480-series sensor correction table, frequency and dBm; READ1, ABOR1/2. No implicit calibration table creation or zero/calibration.

keysight-6674a.scope: 6674A SCPI mode: VOLT/CURR/OUTP, MEAS:VOLT/CURR. Rated site limits capped 60V/35A. Compatibility language not supported.

rs-znb.scope: ZNB8/ZNB20 S11 trace definition, SDAT/STIM data, trigger and RF off. Exact IDN including 2Port/4Port suffix must be specified. Existing correction required by default.

rs-epl.scope: EPL1000 firmware 1.40 manual, receiver bargraph INIT1/TRAC SINGLE, REC detector, frequency/RBW/dBuV. Does not implement full EMI test sequence.

kikusui-pwr-legacy.scope: PWR800L uses TP-BUS via PIA4810/4830/4850 controller. No direct PWR-01 SCPI reuse; controller identity/protocol required.

rs-esu.scope: Spectrum mode, format, trigger, trace and abort

rs-esci.scope: Legacy analyzer command summary and programming examples

rs-fsw.scope: Spectrum application, linear frequency axis, power units; command chapter

rs-esw.scope: Receiver single-frequency bargraph, detector, timing, data format and RF settings

rs-esr.scope: Single-frequency acquisition and SINGLE trace response; receiver command chapter

keysight-xsa-a.scope: X-Series A swept-SA measurement selection and trace mode; SCPI command reference

keysight-xsa-b.scope: X-Series B swept-SA selection, linear axis, ASCII trace export and format

keysight-psa.scope: PSA sweep points and native trace mode; POS/NEG/SAMP only

keysight-mxg-a.scope: N5181A/N5182A SCPI reference: fixed CW, power, modulation/output state

keysight-mxg-b.scope: N5182B SCPI reference: fixed CW, power, modulation/output state

rs-smb100a.scope: CW frequency, fixed power, all modulation off

rs-smb100b.scope: All modulation off and source subsystem; path 1

rs-smw200a.scope: All modulation off, fixed frequency/power; RF path 1 only

kikusui-pwr.scope: PWR2001ML applicability and output state update interval; SCPI reference

keysight-power.scope: Measurement window/input mapping, CONF1 and UNIT1

keysight-u2000.scope: Average mode resets continuous acquisition ON; configure and read commands

rs-nrps.scope: NRP8S/18S, average mode, explicit W/ASCII, buffer OFF, one trigger, INIT/FETCH

rs-nrpa.scope: NRP18A average mode, W/ASCII and one-result measurement

rs-znle.scope: S11 definition, complex data/stimulus, initiation, output, bandwidth and linear sweep

cmt-rvna.scope: RVNA 21.3.1, identity, S11 data, BUS trigger needs continuous ON, RF output, correction state

thermotron-8800.scope: Generic 8800 protocol; equipment-specific controller confirmation still required

hp-437b.scope: Native 3-field identity, FR/SE, TR0/TR2, 26-character SM; scanned pages visually reviewed
